Danau Toba.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic landscape inspired by Danau Toba (Lake Toba) during bright midday. The scene should emphasize the vast volcanic lake as the central focus, with the surrounding landscape styled to reflect the real geography and natural beauty of the Lake Toba region. Include the following elements: Foreground (Grassy Campervan Zone): The bottom portion of the image should remain a wide, flat, and open grassy hilltop, fully covered in short, healthy green grass. This space must be clean and unobstructed — perfect for parking a campervan on grass. The area should look level and natural, without rocks, fences, or trees. You may include subtle variations in sunlight to show texture and realism. Main Focus — Lake Toba: The middle of the image should be occupied entirely by the large, open lake, stretching widely into the scene. The lake surface should appear deep, calm, and reflective, clearly illuminated by the midday sun. Only one main lake should be visible — do not include any smaller lakes, rivers, or streams. Hills and Surrounding Landscape: Mountains should rise in the background above the lake and appear to partially encircle it, mimicking the natural caldera structure of Lake Toba. These should resemble real mountains in the region — softly sloped, forested, and expansive, but not jagged. The surrounding terrain should be minimal and open, especially on the right side, which must remain flat and grassy as part of the campervan zone. Include sparse natural elements along the distant shoreline, but avoid cluttering the scene. Lighting and Atmosphere: Use neutral, bright midday lighting — the sun should be high overhead, casting short, defined shadows. The colors should be vivid and tropical, and the scene should appear crisp and well-defined with no mist or haze. Sky: Keep the sky wide and mostly clear, with light tropical clouds or an open blue gradient suited for midday. Render in sharp, photorealistic style with authentic topography and details drawn from the Lake Toba region. The final image composition should show: a flat grassy campervan zone in the foreground, a wide uninterrupted lake in the midground, and surrounding mountains rising in the distance to frame the lake from above.

Hutan Pinus.prompt: Create a realistic landscape of a serene tropical pine forest during a sunny, bright midday, inspired by Indonesian highland regions. The composition should include: Foreground (Campervan Zone): A wide, flat, and open dirt clearing at the front of the image. The ground should be a natural forest floor with reddish-brown pine soil and scattered short grass. This entire area — including the center, left, and right sides — must be completely clear of trees, bushes, rocks, or any dense vegetation. It should form a smooth, open surface large enough for a campervan to park comfortably. Light tire tracks or subtle flattening can help suggest usability. Pine Trees (Background Only): Tall, straight pine trees should be placed only in the background, extending from the midground to the distant back. These trees should appear evenly spaced and vertical, forming a natural forest wall behind the open area. Do not place any pine trees or foliage in the foreground or on either side of the campervan zone. Lighting: Use sunny, bright midday lighting — with the sun high in the sky casting clear, direct light across the entire scene. The colors should be crisp and vibrant, with strong contrasts and short, defined shadows. The atmosphere should feel warm, tropical, and energetic, with no haze or mist, and all details clearly visible. Underbrush: Keep soft, low forest vegetation near the base of the background pine trees only. Do not place any plants, shrubs, or ferns within the open campervan zone or its edges. Background: Let the pine forest fade naturally into the distance using sharp daylight clarity to create depth. Render in sharp, photorealistic style. The final image must clearly show a clean, sunlit campervan area in the foreground — entirely open — with a structured pine forest only in the background, all bathed in bright, sunny midday light.
